description: Abstract class defining user role management and authorization methods for OrangeHRM system, including user roles, permissions, access control, workflow actions, and data permissions.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: Defines an abstract base for managing user roles, permissions, and access control within OrangeHRM, including methods for retrieving accessible entities, permissions, workflow actions, and roles.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a User object to the manager and computes associated user roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current User object.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Returns the array of UserRole objects assigned to the current user.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entities accessible to the user, based on permissions and roles (deprecated).

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve IDs of entities accessible to the user.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a specific entity is accessible.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if multiple entities are accessible.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve properties of accessible entities (deprecated).

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to list modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check module accessibility.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check screen accessibility within a module.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve API permissions.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check field-level access within a screen.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to get employees associated with a specific role.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract method to compute roles assigned to a user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a workflow action is permitted.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to list allowed workflow actions for the user.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Abstract method to get states where certain actions can be applied.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve merged data group permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to get a collection of data group permissions based on filters.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Abstract method to get default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Abstract method to get the system's home page.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Returns true, indicating if ESS rights are tied to their own workflow.
